name: half-wave rectifier with a saturable reactor
description: A 60 V, 50 Hz source feeds a 5 ohm load through a saturable reactor (0.1 H up to 1 A, 25 mH up to 3 A, 10 mH above) and a diode. The diode conducts while the flux of the reactor is positive; the current peaks at 8.8 A in the saturated segment. The segments of the reactor and the state of the diode are found on the same solutions.
